Remark
1. Remark 1.3\group harmonic-functions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0007 After scaling to the unit ball, the same formulas read \[ u(x)=\frac1{\omega _n}\int _{|\omega |=1}u(x+r\omega )\, d\sigma _\omega , \qquad u(x)=\frac n{\omega _n}\int _{|y|\le 1}u(x+ry)\, dy. \]
